subject.title: Dashboard: workspace time-travel — history scrub, version diff, and widget→logbook blame

question: Should OpenClaw keep dashboard workspace time-travel as an in-repo bundled dashboard feature behind the modular dashboard stack, or defer/move it until the base dashboard storage and security contracts are approved?
rationale: This is a new user-facing auditability surface layered on an unsettled dashboard stack, so automation cannot choose the product boundary, storage model, or security exception for maintainers.

options.title: Keep Open Behind Dashboard Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical time-travel child and require the base dashboard stack plus PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101900 to resolve storage, security, and proof blockers before implementation lands.

options.title: Sponsor A Clean Narrow Implementation
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly sponsor this feature once the branch is restacked around approved SQLite/plugin state and a clear Logbook linking contract.

options.title: Defer Or Move Out Of Core
options.body: If the modular dashboard direction is not current product scope, defer this child or ask for an external plugin experiment rather than an in-repo bundled feature.

recommendation.title: Keep Open Behind Dashboard Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical time-travel child and require the base dashboard stack plus PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101900 to resolve storage, security, and proof blockers before implementation lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The product decision hinges on the Logbook/plugin-tab precedent and bundled Control UI direction introduced in the merged Logbook work.
